name: phase2_paper_group_split
unit: connected components of the paper graph (papers linked by cross-paper questions)
selection_rule: G3 is the only component with 3 dataset questions (the regressed category) and it also has 2 result questions; held-out ≈ 30% of answerable questions.
negatives: neg-01..neg-04 have no gold evidence and are excluded from retrieval metrics in both subsets
limitations: All 42 questions (including G3) were seen when diagnosing the first hybrid design; the choice of BM25 itself was informed by them. The held-out set only guards against tuning the BM25 implementation, k1/b or RRF settings.
Held-out has 11 answerable questions; a single question moves recall@5 by up to ~0.09. Results are preliminary.
BM25 parameters are fixed a priori (k1=1.2, b=0.75; RRF k=60, 20 candidates) and must not be changed in response to held-out results.
